Statewide flood emergency declared in anticipation of spring flooding, per the Governor's release of March 16, 2009, 'Hoeven Declares Statewide Flood Emergency' (the release is no longer online; Wikipedia's 2009 North Dakota floods article cites it).

Emergency declaration for the Northwood tornado of Sunday night, August 26, 2007 in Grand Forks County, issued Monday, August 27 with the National Guard sent to help with cleanup (AP report of August 28; Prairie Public, August 27).

Flood emergency declared March 29, 2004 for 10 counties and the Spirit Lake Indian Reservation, upgraded to a disaster declaration on April 20 and widened to six more northern counties on June 9 (dated report of June 29, 2004).

coverage: 2000-present: the Governor's executive order archive, with Dalrymple's orders read by date and title from December 2010 and numbered orders from 2017, plus the current-EOs page (dates confirmed per order against news releases); Schafer's and Hoeven's 2000-2010 orders are not on the archive, so Hoeven's March 2004 and March 2009 flood emergencies and August 2007 Northwood tornado emergency are added by hand from dated news reports and the Governor's release, and his other orders and undated 2024-2026 orders are still to be backfilled
